items.summary: Persist a per-blog view count in the backend so that every blog post (existing and future) has an initial randomly assigned view count between 700 and 1000 (inclusive), and the value can be read by any caller (publicly visible).

Implement backend APIs to (1) get a single blog's view count, (2) increment a blog's view count by exactly 1 when the blog is opened, and (3) fetch all view counts keyed by blog ID for list rendering.
Ensure existing blog posts receive an initial random view count between 700 and 1000 (inclusive) and continue incrementing by +1 per open thereafter.
Keep view-count storage consistent with blog lifecycle: when a blog post is deleted, its stored view count entry must also be removed so it no longer appears in the "all view counts" result.

Update backend stable state and upgrade behavior to safely introduce persisted blog view counts in the existing single-actor canister, including an upgrade/migration path that preserves existing data (blog posts, users, etc.).
